P:Push 1, 2, 3 onto a stack and remove all values.
M:A stack is last-in-first-out, so the newest value is removed first.
C:Push 1,2,3 -> pop 3,2,1.
V:valid;O(n)
A:[3, 2, 1]

P:Process queue [1, 2, 3] in arrival order.
M:A queue is first-in-first-out, so the oldest value is removed first.
C:1,2,3 -> 1,2,3.
V:valid;O(n)
A:[1, 2, 3]

P:Traverse graph A->B,C; B->D; C->E using BFS starting at A.
M:Visit nodes level by level using a FIFO queue.
C:A, then B,C, then D,E.
V:valid;O(V+E)
A:[A, B, C, D, E]

P:Find the shortest unweighted path from A to E in A->B,C; B->D; C->E.
M:BFS finds the shortest path in an unweighted graph because it explores by distance layers.
C:A -> C -> E has length 2.
V:valid;O(V+E)
A:distance = 2

P:Sort [5, 2, 8, 1, 3] using merge sort.
M:Split the sequence recursively, sort each half, then merge ordered halves.
C:[5,2,8,1,3] -> [1,2,3,5,8]
V:valid;O(nlogn)
A:[1, 2, 3, 5, 8]
